title: Fallout 3 Life-Cycle Lexical Fingerprint Gate
purpose: Test whether the unusual CG02 birthday-poem lexical cluster recurs independently across Fallout 3 and DLC, rather than being an artifact of one note or translation.

seed_record.source: A birthday poem / Growing Up Fast

anti_false_positive_rules: Do not treat a hit inside CG02Note itself as an independent recurrence.
Do not count generic words such as gray, father, death, or life as meaningful alone.
Require either an unusual lexical pair, a multi-term cluster, or a record-context relation.
Separate shipped ESM/DLC evidence from wiki prose and fan commentary.
Do not infer Zetan causality from thematic recurrence.
Do not use translation-only matches as primary evidence when the English record exists.

public_web_preflight_2026_08_10.finding: Exact web searches for the most distinctive CG02 phrases overwhelmingly resolve to the birthday poem itself or mirrors of that same artifact; no independent Fallout 3 record was established from this preflight alone.

required_full_corpus_input: optional REFR/ACHR context for object-level clustering
next_step: Run against complete Fallout3.esm + DLC raw TSV/xEdit corpus and emit record-level hit inventory with FormID, EditorID, record type, matched terms, and context window.
